name: EPIC 247390350

text.card: A red giant 3,027 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.31 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,844 K at its surface.
